data.gender_notes: Finstad is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Finstad is a Scandinavian name derived from the Old Norse words 'fin' meaning 'fine, fair' and 'staðr' meaning 'place, stead'. The name Finstad translates to 'Vale of the steadfast'. It symbolizes a person who remains steadfast in their beliefs or actions, especially in difficult times. The name Finstad carries the meaning “Vale of the steadfast” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Finstad usually hope their child will grow to embody vale of the steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
